environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with reserved concurrency of 1 (serializing all invocations). The KMS key (alias/transaction-signing-key) is backed by a CloudHSM cluster key store (custom key store type: AWS_CLOUDHSM), meaning sign operations have ~50-200ms additional latency routed through the HSM partition. The DynamoDB table has a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster in front with item-level TTL of 0ms (write-through mode). Lambda function URL auth type is AWS_IAM with a resource-based policy restricting to a single IAM role that has a permissions boundary limiting kms:Sign calls to 1 TPS via a service control policy (SCP) on the OU: {"Effect": "Deny", "Action": "kms:Sign", "Condition": {"NumericGreaterThan": {"aws:RequestRate": "1"}}}. The combination of serialized execution (concurrency=1) and the SCP rate limit on the HSM-backed signing operation means concurrent exploitation of the TOCTOU window is not achievable.
